blocks.html: A two-way communication system shall be provided in each occupant evacuation elevator lobby for the purpose of initiating communication with the fire command center or an alternate location approved by the Fire Department. The two-way communication system shall be designed and installed in accordance with Sections 1009.8.1 and 1009.8.2.
